data.name: The 5th Realm
data.detailed_description:
Enter The 5th Realm, a sprawling MMORPG where players can explore vast landscapes, dive into subterranean cities, and shape a world that persists whether they are online or not. Master flexible skill trees, take on dynamic missions, and engage in both traditional and high-intensity PvP combat across land, sea, and air.

Craft and harvest resources in a realistic, hands-on way — swing your tools, fell trees, forge weapons, or craft machinery as your character physically interacts with the world. Build your own player housing, contribute to guilds, and even design one-of-a-kind content that becomes part of the Realm itself.

Socialize with voice and text chat, form communities, and participate in rich cooperative or competitive experiences. The 5th Realm gives you freedom: shape your character, your home, your alliances, and your legacy in a world that rewards creativity and ambition.

  • Realistic crafting & resource gathering — physically interact with the world to harvest, forge, and build.

  • Flexible skill trees and character customization — define height, weight, race, name, and abilities.

  • Dynamic combat system — mix traditional MMORPG mechanics with high-intensity PvP, including land, maritime, and aerial battles.

  • Player housing from modular homes to guild halls and floating city plots.

  • Player-created content — design unique items, creatures, dungeons, music, and artwork that become part of the game.

  • Persistent, living world where missions, buildings, and cities remain across sessions.

  • Immersive social systems — voice chat, text channels, and professions centered on interaction (Musician, Dancer, Folklorist).

  • Dynamic missions and quests with potential for high-level players to create custom instances.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: quad core Intel or AMD processor 2.5 GHZ or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: supported DX11 or higher GPU with 4GB minimum VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any modern sound card
  • VR Support: TBA
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Sound Card: Any modern surround sound card
